# SwitchYard FX

> SwitchYard FX is a Sydney-based corporate foreign exchange (FX) risk management firm for Australian mid-market CFOs and treasury teams. It provides FX forward contracts, options and zero-cost structures, cross-border payments, FX risk strategy advisory and on-demand treasury support.

- Legal entity: Switchyard Capital Pty Ltd, an Authorised Representative (ASIC AR No. 001318359) of Ebury Partners Australia Pty Limited (ACN 632 570 702), which holds Australian Financial Services Licence (AFSL) 520548 and is registered with AUSTRAC.
- Location: Sydney, NSW, Australia
- Phone: 02 7226 3680 (+61 2 7226 3680)
- Email: admin@switchyardfx.com.au
- Book a free 15-minute FX strategy consultation: https://cal.com/hannahdevjak
- Information on this site is general in nature and does not constitute financial advice.

## Services

- [Forward Contracts](https://www.switchyardfx.com.au/services#forward-contracts): Lock in exchange rates today for future settlements. No upfront premium; customisable maturity dates and amounts. Used for overseas supplier payments, forecast revenue hedging, M&A costs and dividend repatriation.
- [Options & Zero Cost Structures](https://www.switchyardfx.com.au/services#options): Protect against adverse currency moves while retaining upside. Flexible premiums and customisable strikes; suited to tenders, strategic deals and M&A.
- [Payments & Settlements](https://www.switchyardfx.com.au/services#payments): Cross-border payments with competitive FX pricing, transparent fees, multi-currency capability and same-day or T+1 settlement, delivered through Ebury.
- [Risk Strategy Advisory](https://www.switchyardfx.com.au/services#risk-advisory): Hedging policy development, scenario analysis and stress testing, board-level reporting frameworks.
- [Treasury Support](https://www.switchyardfx.com.au/services#treasury-support): On-demand advisory for complex transactions.

## How SwitchYard works

1. Assess: analyse FX exposure, cash flows and risk tolerance.
2. Hedge: design and execute tailored strategies (forwards, options or custom structures).
3. Track: monitoring and reporting of positions and P&L.
4. Report: monthly compliance and strategy reviews.
